metabolism:
!METABOLISM
if stock['stamina'] = 5: stock['metabolism'] += 1
if stock['stamina'] = 1: stock['metabolism'] -= 1
if stock['metabolism'] < 1: stock['metabolism'] = 1
if stock['metabolism'] > 5: stock['metabolism'] = 5
learning:
! JO9 MOD START COG_GENERATE | 2026-10-16_innate_learning_traits
! 신규 무작위 생성만 추첨: 1~3 천재, 4~6 백치, 7~100 특성 없음.
! 고정 프리셋과 기존 인물에는 추첨하지 않는다. 지성과 자아의 이후 변화는 기존 규칙을 따른다.
if special_stock = 0:
 stock['jo9_learning_trait'] = 0
 jo9_learning_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_learning_roll <= 3:
  stock['jo9_learning_trait'] = 1
  stock['intellect'] = 5
  stock_rate['intellect'] = 0
 elseif jo9_learning_roll <= 6:
  stock['jo9_learning_trait'] = -1
  stock['intellect'] = 0
  stock_rate['intellect'] = 0
 end
end
stock['neg_slave'] = 1 + stock['pride'] + stock['temper'] + stock['ego'] + stock['intellect'] - stock['rational'] - stock['custom']
! JO9 MOD END COG_GENERATE
commonRegistry:
if $args[0] = 'generate':
 ! 호출자가 새 무작위 인물일 때만 이 모드를 호출합니다. 기존 인물은 재추첨하지 않습니다.
! JO9 MOD START ARGON_RESTORED_GENERATE | 2026-10-19_argon_trait_text_integration
! JO9 MOD START ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
! Fellatio addiction and gag reflex are opposites. One roll keeps each at 10 percent without overlap.
 stock['oral_affinity'] = 0
 stock['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 10: stock['oral_affinity'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 10 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 20: stock['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 1
! JO9 MOD END ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
 stock['anal_affinity'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 10: stock['anal_affinity'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 10 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 20: stock['anal_affinity'] = -1
! JO9 MOD START DISPOSITION_ROLL | 2026-10-23_disposition_traits
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 stock['defiant'] = 0
 stock['jo9_slave_nature'] = 0
 stock['jo9_slave_nature_initialized'] = 0
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 2:
  local jo9x_draw_defiant = 1
  if func('jo9_traits', 'allow', 'stock', 'defiant', jo9x_draw_defiant) = 1:
   stock['defiant'] = jo9x_draw_defiant
   gs 'jo9_traits', 'repair_exclusions', 'stock'
  end
 end
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 2 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 7 and stock['ego'] < 4 and stock['pride'] < 4:
  local jo9x_draw_jo9_slave_nature = 1
  if func('jo9_traits', 'allow', 'stock', 'jo9_slave_nature', jo9x_draw_jo9_slave_nature) = 1:
   stock['jo9_slave_nature'] = jo9x_draw_jo9_slave_nature
   gs 'jo9_traits', 'repair_exclusions', 'stock'
  end
 end
! JO9 MOD END DISPOSITION_ROLL
 stock['jo9_voice_trait'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll = 1:
  local jo9x_draw_jo9_voice_trait = 1
  if func('jo9_traits', 'allow', 'stock', 'jo9_voice_trait', jo9x_draw_jo9_voice_trait) = 1:
   stock['jo9_voice_trait'] = jo9x_draw_jo9_voice_trait
   gs 'jo9_traits', 'repair_exclusions', 'stock'
  end
 end
 stock['jo9_oral_xp_credit'] = 0
 stock['jo9_anal_xp_credit'] = 0
 stock['jo9_defiant_resolved'] = 0
 stock['jo9_ambition'] = 0
! JO9 MOD END ARGON_RESTORED_GENERATE
 if rand(1,100) <= 10: stock['jo9_ambition'] = 1
 stock['jo9_work_ethic'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 10 and func('jo9_traits', 'allow', 'stock', 'jo9_work_ethic', 1) = 1: stock['jo9_work_ethic'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 10 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 20: stock['jo9_work_ethic'] = -1
 gs 'jo9_traits', 'activity_generate', 'stock'
 stock['jo9_focus'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 10: stock['jo9_focus'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 10 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 20: stock['jo9_focus'] = -1
 stock['jo9_grudge'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 10: stock['jo9_grudge'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 10 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 20: stock['jo9_grudge'] = -1
 stock['jo9_constitution'] = 0
 jo9_trait_registry_roll = rand(1,100)
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 3: stock['jo9_constitution'] = 1
 if jo9_trait_registry_roll > 3 and jo9_trait_registry_roll <= 6: stock['jo9_constitution'] = -1
 stock['jo9_peerless'] = 0
 if stock['beauty'] >= 5:
  if rand(1,100) = 1: stock['jo9_peerless'] = 1
 end
 stock['jo9_ambition_known'] = 0
 stock['jo9_work_ethic_known'] = 0
 stock['jo9_focus_known'] = 0
 stock['jo9_grudge_known'] = 0
 killvar 'jo9_trait_registry_roll'
allowAndRepair:
if $args[0] = 'allow':
 result = 1
 local jo9x_candidate = args[3]
 if jo9x_candidate = 0: exit
 local jo9x_previous = dyneval('result = ' + $args[1] + "['" + $args[2] + "']")
 if jo9x_previous = jo9x_candidate: exit
 result = dyneval($replace({
  result = 1
  if ($args[0] = 'darkness_attitude' or $args[0] = 'blood_attitude' or $args[0] = 'fire_attitude' or $args[0] = 'water_attitude' or $args[0] = 'vermin_attitude' or $args[0] = 'deprivation_attitude') and args[1] = -1:
   if jo9xeactor['courage'] = 2: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'meekness':
   if args[1] < 0 and jo9xeactor['jo9_slave_nature'] = 1: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'defiant' and args[1] = 1:
   if jo9xeactor['meekness'] > 0 or jo9xeactor['jo9_slave_nature'] = 1: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'jo9_voice_trait' and args[1] = 1:
   if jo9xeactor['expression_affinity'] > 0: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'cowSK_affinity' and args[1] > 0:
   if jo9xeactor['sport_affinity'] = 1 or func('jo9_traits', 'activity_value', 'jo9xeactor', 'jo9_work_ethic') = 1 or func('jo9_traits', 'activity_value', 'jo9xeactor', 'passion_comfort') = -1: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'sport_affinity' and args[1] = 1:
   if jo9xeactor['cowSK_affinity'] > 0: result = 0
  end
! JO9 MOD START ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
  if $args[0] = 'jo9_gag_reflex' and args[1] = 1:
   if jo9xeactor['oral_affinity'] > 0: result = 0
  end
  if $args[0] = 'oral_affinity' and args[1] > 0:
   if jo9xeactor['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 1: result = 0
  end
! JO9 MOD END ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
  if ($args[0] = 'jo9_work_ethic' and args[1] = 1) or ($args[0] = 'passion_comfort' and args[1] = -1):
   if jo9xeactor['cowSK_affinity'] > 0: result = 0
  end
 }, 'jo9xeactor', $args[1]), $args[2], jo9x_candidate)
 exit
end

! Repair only approved positive/negative conflicts in this actor. Save files are not edited.
if $args[0] = 'repair_exclusions':
 result = 0
 dynamic $replace({
  if jo9xeactor['courage'] = 2:
   if jo9xeactor['darkness_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['darkness_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
   if jo9xeactor['blood_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['blood_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
   if jo9xeactor['fire_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['fire_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
   if jo9xeactor['water_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['water_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
   if jo9xeactor['vermin_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['vermin_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
   if jo9xeactor['deprivation_attitude'] = -1: jo9xeactor['deprivation_attitude'] = 0 & result += 1
  end
  if jo9xeactor['jo9_slave_nature'] = 1 and jo9xeactor['meekness'] < 0: jo9xeactor['meekness'] = 0 & result += 1
  if jo9xeactor['jo9_slave_nature'] = 1 and jo9xeactor['defiant'] = 1: jo9xeactor['defiant'] = 0 & result += 1
  if jo9xeactor['meekness'] > 0 and jo9xeactor['defiant'] = 1: jo9xeactor['defiant'] = 0 & result += 1
  if jo9xeactor['expression_affinity'] > 0 and jo9xeactor['jo9_voice_trait'] = 1: jo9xeactor['jo9_voice_trait'] = 0 & result += 1
! JO9 MOD START ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
  if jo9xeactor['oral_affinity'] > 0 and jo9xeactor['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 1: jo9xeactor['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 0 & result += 1
! JO9 MOD END ORAL_GAG_EXCLUSION_20261108
 }, 'jo9xeactor', $args[1])
 exit
end
